The reporting guidelines will include a suggested reporting structure, which can be tailored to the specific needs of each country.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration review the tripartite agreement and ensure that it clearly identifies the responsibilities of the peace and development advisers, as well as of the managers of the agreement, and that the advisers’ reports are submitted in a timely, consistent manner, following a standardized report template.
history.administration_response: The tripartite agreement was updated and approved by the Joint Programme Steering Committee on 4 December 2024 and is being circulated to country offices for signature. The revised tripartite agreement was circulated to peace and development advisers at the end of December 2024 and is included in the induction package for newly deployed peace and development advisers. Reporting requirements are clarified in section 2.3. of the revised document. The peace and development advisers are also expected to maintain close contact with relevant focal points in UNDP and the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs through regular exchanges. The peace and development advisers are responsible for providing regular analytical reports and context-specific updates to the resident coordinator, UNDP (Regional Representative, Regional Bureau), and the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs-Department of Peace Operations regional division. Reports should be prepared monthly unless otherwise agreed. A different reporting frequency can be adopted, if required by the country context, and agreed upon by the managers of the tripartite agreement. Recipients are invited to provide feedback on the reports and to share information with peace and development advisers to ensure mutual exchange and information-sharing. In the analytical reporting guidelines for the peace and development advisers, more information is provided on the expected frequency and format of, and the responsibilities relating to, reporting. The Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the tripartite agreement was updated and approved by the Joint Programme Steering Committee on 4 December 2024 and is being circulated to country offices for signature, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
